mapper.select: SELECT T.USER_ID ,T.CODE ,U.NICKNAME FROM T_AI_TRADER T JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = T.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY T.CODE

SELECT L.ID AS LOG_ID ,L.USER_ID ,T.CODE ,U.NICKNAME ,L.TRADE_DATE ,L.STATUS ,L.MARKET_VIEW ,L.DIARY ,L.ORDERS_JSON ,L.TOTAL_ASSET ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM L.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT FROM T_AI_TRADE_LOG L JOIN T_AI_TRADER T ON T.USER_ID = L.USER_ID JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = L.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND L.STATUS <> 'FAIL' ORDER BY L.TRADE_DATE DESC, T.CODE LIMIT #{limit}

WITH U AS ( SELECT S.ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.MARKET ,ROUND(S.LAST_CLOSE * S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING / 100000000)::BIGINT AS CAP_EOK FROM T_STOCK S WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND S.SECURITY_TYPE = 'STOCK' AND S.LAST_CLOSE IS NOT NULL AND S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING IS NOT NULL ORDER BY S.LAST_CLOSE * S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC LIMIT #{limit} ), R AS ( SELECT P.STOCK_ID ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.STOCK_ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P JOIN U ON U.ID = P.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND P.TRADE_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE - 45 ), D AS ( SELECT R.STOCK_ID ,R.RN ,R.CLOSE_PRICE ,LN(R.CLOSE_PRICE / NULLIF(LEAD(R.CLOSE_PRICE) OVER (PARTITION BY R.STOCK_ID ORDER BY R.RN), 0)) AS LR FROM R WHERE 1=1 AND R.RN <= 21 AND R.CLOSE_PRICE > 0 ) SELECT U.ID AS STOCK_ID ,U.SYMBOL ,U.NAME ,U.MARKET ,U.CAP_EOK ,MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 1 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS CLOSE_PRICE ,ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 1 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 6 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END), 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS RET5 ,ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 1 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 21 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END), 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS RET20 ,ROUND((STDDEV_SAMP(D.LR) * SQRT(252) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS VOL_ANNUAL FROM U JOIN D ON D.STOCK_ID = U.ID GROUP BY U.ID, U.SYMBOL, U.NAME, U.MARKET, U.CAP_EOK HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN D.RN = 1 THEN D.CLOSE_PRICE END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY U.CAP_EOK DESC

SELECT X.SYMBOL ,X.NAME ,X.TITLE ,TO_CHAR(X.PUB_DATE, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PUB_AT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (N.TITLE) S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,N.TITLE ,N.PUB_DATE FROM T_NEWS N JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = N.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND N.PUB_DATE >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') - INTERVAL '36 hours' ORDER BY N.TITLE, N.PUB_DATE DESC ) X ORDER BY X.PUB_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT X.TITLE ,TO_CHAR(X.PUB_DATE, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PUB_AT FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (N.TITLE) N.TITLE ,N.PUB_DATE FROM T_NEWS N WHERE 1=1 AND N.CATEGORY = 'MARKET' AND N.PUB_DATE >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') - INTERVAL '36 hours' ORDER BY N.TITLE, N.PUB_DATE DESC ) X ORDER BY X.PUB_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}
